request: async func(u64) -> map<string,u64> as an ordinary public WAsmC value
decision: unsupported as a whole: u64 is supported in the v0.0.21 compiler, but async ordinary source and a direct public map result remain independently unsupported
independent_stops: Map is resident/local only and unsupported as a direct public WIT value result
alternatives: u32 or i64 only with application-owned bounds and signedness proof
ordered list<Entry<K,V>> snapshot only when copied-value semantics are equivalent
declared resource for identity and mutation
